classification.difficultyReason: Identify two rectangular ribbon loops on a gift box, then calculate ribbon for multiple gifts including waste.

content.prompt: A gift is wrapped with two ribbons as shown below.

children.label: a
children.prompt: Calculate the length of ribbon A and ribbon B, then add them to find the total length.

spec.description: Unfilled oblique rectangular gift box preserving the source front, top and right view. Blue ribbon A crosses the top along the length and descends the right face; blue ribbon B crosses the depth of the top and descends the centre of the front face. Black leaders identify A, B and the depth. Visible boundaries and silhouettes are solid black; the three obscured cuboid edges are dashed.
spec.mathematics: Length 30 cm, height 10 cm and depth 6 cm. Ribbon A forms a rectangular loop around length and height; ribbon B forms a rectangular loop around depth and height. The explicit eight-vertex cuboid uses these dimensions. All vertices have projected coordinates. Visibility is derived from the six faces and recorded viewing direction; semantic ribbon segments are drawn separately.
spec.answerVisibility: Dimensions and ribbon identifiers are permanent student-visible givens. Ribbon lengths and totals appear only in answers.

visibility.semanticPaths: The source-visible blue ribbon segments remain independent of cuboid edges.
visibility.labels: Complete labels retain 10 pt native fonts and use non-drawing paths; black leader arrows are separate annotations.

spec.intentionalDeparture: Explicit dashed obscured cuboid edges implement the visibility contract while preserving the source projection, dimensions, ribbon arrangement and original evidence.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}
A&=30+10+30+10\\
A&=80\text{ cm}\\
B&=6+10+6+10\\
B&=32\text{ cm}\\
\text{Total length}&=80+32\\
\text{Total length}&=112\text{ cm}
\end{align*}$$

children.label: b
children.prompt: If you wanted to wrap 50 of these gifts the same way, how much ribbon would you need, if 5 cm of ribbon is wasted for each box during the wrapping process?
